message:
你正在执行一个已经由管理员单独批准的补偿操作。只能处理合同中指定的副作用，不得扩大资源、参数或作用域。
原步骤：受控写入样本
<COMPENSATION_CONTRACT>
{"compensation_id": "compensation-31b283395efc", "contract_hash": "5251229f8bff2d327a41ca7377cf94fc53347170803835785d657a970acba5a2", "type": "manual_recovery", "instructions": "本次只读核实当前资源与回执，不再写入样本。缺失、损坏或合同不匹配时保持暂停；重新批准后仅允许引用预备的、经核实匹配合同的独立有效回执。不得覆盖旧证据，不外发。", "resource": "/Users/apple/工作桌面/Workspace/agent-system/docs/review/computer-use-phase13-20261006/missing-sample.txt", "idempotency_key": "recovery:compensation-31b283395efc:5251229f8bff2d327a41", "original_effect": {"id": "effect-9a7a6b093646179bd883", "mission_id": "mission-6f67978cafd2", "mission_run_id": "mrun-3f66975843cc4eb1", "correlation_id": "mission-eae7fc4ab50f4c05", "plan_version": 1, "step_id": "step-ba485a335056", "work_run_id": null, "effect_key": "unreported-effect", "resource": "/Users/apple/工作桌面/Workspace/agent-system/docs/review/computer-use-phase13-20261006/missing-sample.txt", "action": "受控写入样本", "status": "unknown", "idempotency_key": "mission-6f67978cafd2:plan:1:step:1", "receipt_ref": null, "fingerprint": "9a7a6b093646179bd883f0f44c4338f5cf33d95402a469f26ccc5a228a6193b1", "reported_at": "2026-10-06T07:24:36.003869+00:00", "updated_at": "2026-10-06T07:24:36.003871+00:00", "evidence_refs": [], "metadata": {"synthetic": true, "reason": "executor_did_not_report_effect"}}}
</COMPENSATION_CONTRACT>
original_effect.fingerprint 是副作用记录的去重标识，不是文件内容哈希，不得将它与资源内容哈希比较或据此推断资源被篡改。manual_recovery 成功必须提供真实本地 JSON 回执及 receipt_sha256；回执必须包含当前 contract_hash、idempotency_key、resource、post_recovery_sha256、verification.all_passed=true，evidence_refs 必须包含回执绝对路径。后端只验证允许交付目录内的普通文件及恢复后内容；不支持的远端资源应返回 failed。回执缺失或损坏时禁止凭成功描述放行，禁止无证据重放写入。所有外部写操作必须原样使用合同 idempotency_key。执行完成后只输出一个 JSON 对象，不要 Markdown：{"summary":"补偿结果摘要","status":"reverted|not_needed|failed","receipt_ref":"可定位的补偿回执","receipt_sha256":"本地恢复回执的 SHA256","evidence_refs":["日志或验证引用"],"risk_notes":"剩余风险或无"}。没有回执和证据不得声称补偿完成。
